entry.title: HELLENISTIC
entry.text: HELLENISTIC, OF HARRISTIC LANDOABT, that ufed by the Greenian Jews who lived in Egypt and other parts where the Greek tango prevailed. In this lan- gauge it is fail the Septragint was written, and all the books of the New Telmaners; and that it was thus denominated to these that it was Greek filled with He- brafinn and Syriacifine.
